note: Complete. All six stages measured from Strava.

banner.title: Finished — 57:37
banner.body: David finished the Mega Epic at 18:37 on Friday evening: all six Breck Epic stage courses ridden end to end as one continuous effort, 216 miles and 32,717 feet of climbing, in 57 hours 37 minutes against a 58-hour target. 34:54 of that was spent moving. Gold Dust, the last stage, was the fastest of the six — 4:27 of riding after fifty-three hours on the course. Thanks to everyone who watched the dot.
